first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A person wearing a heavy white extravehicular suit and carrying a large white rectangular backpack, with dark red bands around the legs, located on the image-left side of the silver-blue cylindrical module section and gripping a handrail.

entities.name: planetary background
entities.identification: The bright blue-white distant view in the upper part of the image, with white cloud-like textures and a locally visible pale-blue bright edge, partially occluded by Person A and the module section.

entities.name: black outer-space background
entities.identification: The nearly uniform deep-black background outside Person A, the planetary background, and the extravehicular structures.

entities.name: gold foil-covered equipment assembly
entities.identification: The gold reflective foil-covered equipment partially visible along the bottom edge of the image, adjacent to a dark support above, with its complete shape cropped by the bottom boundary.

entities.name: silver-blue cylindrical module section
entities.identification: The large cylindrical structure occupying the image-right side, with a dark blue-gray curved sidewall, a silver end face, and an orange-gold annular handrail.

entities.name: gray-blue curved panel surface
entities.identification: The gray-blue panel surface with a curved outer edge in the lower part of the image; rectangular subdivisions and dark and light patches become visible later, and it is partially occluded by both of Person A's legs.

At frame 0, Person A's backpack faces the camera. Person A wears a heavy white extravehicular suit with a large white rectangular backpack and dark red bands around the legs; a light-colored boot and relatively thick sole are visible at the lower image-left. The sleeves and legs have segmented folds; a rectangular panel, gray frame, light-colored strap-like fasteners, buckles, and a small dark panel are visible on the backpack; a light-colored box-like component and a dark lattice-like assembly are present on the side of the torso; and parts of a glove and the side of the helmet are visible.

At frame 0, the silver-blue cylindrical module section has a dark blue-gray curved sidewall, a silver circular end face, and an orange-gold annular handrail. The sidewall has rows of rivets and panel seams, and the handrail is supported by spaced mounts. The end face has parallel fine lines, a gold divider band, groups of circular fasteners, and light and dark reflections; the edge has a dark annular frame and light-colored components protruding outward.

At frame 0, the planetary background is bright blue-white, with a pale-blue bright rim along part of its curved edge. White cloud bands and pale-blue areas are visible on the surface, which is partially occluded by Person A's backpack and the sidewall of the silver-blue cylindrical module section.

At frame 0, the black outer-space background is nearly uniform deep black and is exposed beyond the bright edge of the planetary background and between both of Person A's legs and the end face of the silver-blue cylindrical module section; a very small number of faint bright points are locally visible.

At frame 0, the gold foil-covered equipment assembly is only partially visible, exposing a gold reflective surface and a dark support above it, while the rest is cropped by the bottom edge of the image.

At frame 0, the gold foil-covered equipment assembly is only partially visible. Its gold reflective surface has irregular wrinkles and light and dark facets, its top is adjacent to a dark support, and the rest is cropped by the bottom edge of the image.

The end face has parallel fine lines, a gold divider band, groups of circular fasteners, and light and dark reflections; the edge has a dark annular frame and light-colored components protruding outward.
